facts.fact: ARPCE's postal regulation director reported progress on the national digital addressing platform, provisionally named Système de localisation mixte, which was demonstrated at a steering committee meeting on 9 October 2024 ahead of a final presentation to the authorities in November.

ARPCE's digital postal addressing project, run with town halls and partner administrations, was launched in April 2022, has had a legal framework since July 2025 in the decree on national postal codification, and was presented in Brazzaville on 15 October 2026.

Arpce presented the results of its digital postal addressing project in Brazzaville on 15 October 2026; its postal regulation director said it will help identify and locate people, households, firms and infrastructure across the national territory.
